snippet.title: Dark Rail - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
#steam 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4553620?utm_source=jandu&utm_campaign=announce&utm_medium=youtube

Dark Rail is a turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness.


- Hunt down heretics by train: Send your inquisitors out by train on deadly quests to hunt down heretics across the frontier. The prisoner shipments must never stop, no matter the cost.
- Manage your resources: Every choice affects Revolt, Resources, and Madness. Resource management is the key to lasting another day.
- Choose the paths your inquisitors will take: Level up your inquisitors, train them for specialized roles, and assign new skills.
- Choose  your path with the meta upgrades: Earn Blood Points by sacrificing prisoners and completing shipment quotas, then spend them to unlock powerful new abilities, bonuses, and lasting advantages for future runs.
- Unique powers to defeat monsters each run: Each run lets you choose different abilities to shape your strategy and face the dangers ahead.

@2026 Jandusoft & Steam Veil Games
